title: Amid influx of decompiled games, new Xbox lab to explore AI-created ports
quotes: Xbox CEO Asha Sharma: in recent weeks, we've seen games rapidly decompiled and rebuilt to run on hardware they were never originally designed to support.
Windows PC builds have been translated to run on Apple Silicon or ported to run inside a browser through WebAssembly and WebGPU, the latter now approaching 90% global browser support.

title: GameMaker will let indie developers sell their games for free from 2027
quotes: Developers will be able to sell GMRT games on desktop, mobile, web and GX Games without a Professional licence.
Head of GameMaker Russell Kay: "As GMRT continues to roll out in beta across platforms, we are widening the scope of what we provide to developers."
